title: Microglial cell culture method
abstract: The invention discloses a culture method of microglial cells. The culture method comprises the following steps: transferring tissues into a centrifuge tube filled with pre-cooled HBSS for treatment; discarding a supernatant, adding preheated pancreatin containing leukemia inhibitory factors (LIF), and slightly shaking to enable the tissue to be in full contact with the digestive juice to obtain atissue solution; adding lIF into a culture medium of fetal calf serum; adding the isopyknic culture medium into a tissue solution to terminate digestion; adding an LIF-containing culture medium, and repeatedly blowing and beating by using a spear tip to disperse and filter the cells so as to obtain a single-cell suspension; and inoculating the single-cell suspension into a plurality of cell culture flasks for culturing. On the basis of a traditional mixed glial cell culture method, LIF is added into pancreatin and a culture medium, and microglial cells are separated by adopting a shaking tableoscillation method, so that the microglial cells which are not easy to activate can be obtained, and the method has important significance for obtaining the neuroglial cells in a resting state for adrug evaluation experiment.
